positions.as_written: Measure alignment when the adduction moment is the clinical question, since it is the available proxy.
Offer a cane in the opposite hand for medial compartment pain, on mechanical grounds.
Prefer impulse over peak when the question is cumulative exposure rather than a single step.

Address body mass alongside correction, since it can exceed the surgical effect.
State the observational nature of the progression association when counselling.
Plan correction to a mechanical axis target and confirm it radiographically.
